question: The slant height of a cone is 20 cm. If area of its base is 616 cm², then what is the curved surface area of this cone ? (use π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Standard Circle Data: Radius 7 → Area 154 | Radius 14 → Area 616.

Base Area = 616 cm² ⇒ Radius (r) = 14 cm.

Slant height (l) = 20 cm.

CSA = π × r × l = (22/7) × 14 × 20 = 44 × 20 = 880 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 880 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Slant height (l) = 20 cm

Area of base = 616 cm²

Value of π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Area of base of cone = πr²

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of cone = πrl

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/662faf10b6529e6835cc3812a626b1892c1e5ba2d6eecf05b7b52b42ba4f265a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of base = πr² = 616

⇒ (22/7) × r² = 616

⇒ r² = 616 × (7/22)

⇒ r² = 28 × 7 = 196

⇒ r = √196 = 14 cm

⇒ Curved Surface Area (CSA) = π × r × l

⇒ CSA = (22/7) × 14 × 20

⇒ CSA = 22 × 2 × 20

⇒ CSA = 880 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 880 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cone

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the base area: TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume of a Cone

The space occupied by the cone is given by: Volume = (1/3) × πr²h, where h is the vertical height.

Slant Height Relation

The relationship between slant height (l), vertical height (h), and radius (r) is: l² = r² + h².</p
